# Shark Attack: National Geographic Kids Learning to Read (Level 3) Book by Litera

Dive into the exciting world of marine life with **Atacul rechinilor**! This educational book from National Geographic Kids, published by Litera, is designed to fuel curiosity and build essential reading skills for young children. Perfect for readers advancing their literacy journey.

## Why Reading Great Adventures Matters

Children possess an innate curiosity about the world around them. The *National Geographic* collection of "Learning to Read" books taps into this powerful motivation. By combining engaging storiesâlike a thrilling shark encounterâwith educational content, this book helps children discover interesting facts while mastering the art of reading.

Reading is fundamental for academic performance. This title motivates young readers, nurturing their desire to learn more and build confidence in their literary skills.

## Product Features: National Geographic Learning Level 3

This specific volume, **Atacul rechinilor**, targets students at an advanced reading level (Level 3), providing the structured challenge necessary for continued growth. The book is designed with sophisticated learning elements to ensure maximum educational impact:

*   **Advanced Reading Material:** Contains a minimum of 1300 words across 48 pages, ensuring extensive exposure to varied vocabulary and syntax.
*   **Structured Learning:** Includes text divided into chapters, allowing for focused study and progressive skill development.
*   **Grammatical Complexity:** Features sentences of varying lengths and increasingly complex grammatical structures, challenging readers to improve comprehension.
*   **Self-Paced Practice:** The book includes a comprehensive questionnaire at the end of the text, enabling parents or educators to assess understanding after reading.

## Product Details

*   **Brand:** Litera
*   **Category:** Children's Education (Copii)
*   **Level:** 3 (Advanced Reading Skills)
*   **Page Count:** 48 pages
*   **Price:** $24.99

[Learn more and purchase the book here by visiting the official Litera store](https://event.2performant.com/events/click?ad_type=product_store&unique=aa42074f3&aff_code=bf1d69700&campaign_unique=0a8a2c4d9)

---

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book appropriate for very young readers?**
A: No. This is designated as Level 3, meaning it is intended for children who have already established foundational reading skills and are ready to tackle more complex grammar and vocabulary.

**Q: What kind of educational content can I expect?**
A: Beyond the narrative (Shark Attack), you will find factual information about marine life drawn from National Geographic's extensive resources, alongside structured exercises and questionnaires to reinforce learning.

**Q: Does the book focus only on sharks?**
A: While the theme is "Shark Attack," the overall collection aims to provide interesting facts about the world, utilizing the thrilling subject matter as a vehicle for learning.
